_comment: Copy this file to profile.json and fill in YOUR details.
_note: profile.json is gitignored — your personal data stays local.
name: Alex Chen
_seniority_note: Sets the minimum seniority for the rank agent to score against. Jobs clearly below this level receive a -2 score penalty.
_roles_note: The AI scores every job against these titles. List your actual target roles, most specific first.
_countries_note: Must match country names used in job listings. Supported: USA, UK, Australia, New Zealand, Canada, India, Singapore, Germany, Netherlands, Global.
_skills_note: Be specific — these exact terms are compared against job descriptions during ranking.
_metrics_note: These metrics help the rank agent understand your impact. Fill in YOUR real numbers — they make scoring more accurate.

canonical_metrics.team_size: Led teams of up to 25 across AI/CX programs
canonical_metrics.note: Replace with your own measurable achievements

_sheet_note: This was used for Google Sheets output in earlier versions. Currently ignored — output goes to CSV.
_queries_note: Each query runs separately via Tavily. The 7-day freshness filter is enforced at the API level. Be specific — include job title, remote, and year for best results.
search_queries: site:seek.com.au "head of AI" OR "director of AI" OR "AI strategy" remote contract 2026
site:nz.seek.com "AI automation" OR "AI strategy" senior director remote 2026
site:reed.co.uk "AI transformation" OR "AI consultant" OR "agentic AI" remote contract 2026
site:uk.indeed.com "AI strategy" OR "CX automation" director senior remote 2026
site:indeed.com "AI transformation" OR "agentic AI" director senior remote contract 2026
"head of AI" OR "director AI" OR "VP AI" remote "work from anywhere" OR "globally remote" 2026
"AI strategy consultant" OR "CX AI automation" director senior remote globally 2026
"agentic AI" OR "AI automation" consultant senior director remote contract 2026
site:linkedin.com/jobs "AI transformation" OR "AI strategy" director remote globally 2026
site:remoterocketship.com "AI consultant" OR "head of AI" senior remote 2026
_broad_queries_note: These are used as a fallback if the main queries return fewer than 5 total results. Keep them broader.
_exclude_note: Any job whose title contains one of these strings (case-insensitive) is rejected by the rank agent before scoring.
_threshold_note: Jobs scoring below this number are not saved to the tracker. Range: 0-10. Default 5 keeps the middle ground.
_max_results_note: Tavily results returned per query. Higher = more raw results but slower and uses more Tavily quota. Default 5 is a good balance.
_days_note: Freshness window. Tavily enforces this at the query level. 7 means only jobs posted in the last week.
_model_note: Ollama model for parse and rank nodes. Must be installed via 'ollama pull <model>'. Recommended: mistral:7b. Alternatives: qwen2.5:7b, llama3.2:3b.
